name: FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_EXECUTIONS
description: This table contains diagnostics and telemetry data for flow executions, providing real-time monitoring that captures essential metrics and statuses for flow instances.

columns.name: FLOW_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the input and output flow execution for the document's input and output flow instance.

columns.name: FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the input and output flow of the document instance.

columns.name: INPUT_PAYLOAD_JSON
columns.description: Input payload for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: SUBMITTER
columns.description: Submitter for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: OUTPUT_DOCUMENT_TYPE_LIST
columns.description: Output document types for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PROCESS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies primary process type for the Document IO flow instance.Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_STEP_TYPES.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Indentifies the primary process ID for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: INCOMING_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Indentifies the incoming document ID for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Indicates start date and time of the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Indicates end date and time of the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: EXECUTION_CUT_OFF_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the cutoff time to execute the input and output flow of the document instance, measured in seconds.

columns.name: OUTPUT_DOCUMENT_PATH
columns.description: Output document path for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies notification type for the Document IO flow instance.Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_NOTIFICATIONS.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_DETAILS
columns.description: Notification details for the Document IO flow instance.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Identifies status for the Document IO flow instance.Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_STATUSES.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
